home2.heroSub: 12 answers per question. Take turns, score big, avoid 11 and 12.
home2.categoriesHint: Tap one to host a game with it

how.s1b: Every question has exactly 12 answers, ranked 1 to 12.
how.s2b: Say an answer on your turn. The host taps it. Turns go round until every positive answer is found.
how.s3b: Ranks 1–9 give 1–9 points, rank 10 gives 20. Ranks 11 and 12 cost you 11 and 12.
how.s4b: Wild ×5 one answer — negative too. Streak gives you one more answer after a correct one.
how.s5b: Reach 100 and the game ends after that question. Highest score wins; ties play a tie-breaker.

rules.title: How to play
rules.flow1: The app picks a question from the chosen categories.
rules.flow2: Players answer out loud in turn; the host taps the answer or Wrong.
rules.flow3: Claimed answers show for everyone; the rest stay hidden.
rules.flow4: Turns go round again until ranks 1–10 are all found, or the host ends the question.
rules.flow5: The full ranking is revealed and the next question starts with the next player.
rules.end1: First to 100 points ends the game after the current question.
rules.end2: Highest score wins. A tie means a tie-breaker question for the tied players only.
rules.combo: Claim both rank 11 and rank 12 in the same question (on any turns) and the pair is worth +20 instead of −23. Wild does not multiply it.
